description.narrative: An investment of up to BAM 30 million (equivalent to €15.3 million) through a private placement in Minimum Requirement for Own Funds and Eligible Liabilities ("MREL")-eligible local currency bonds issued by Raiffeisen Bank dd BiH ("RBBH"). The bonds will be contractually eligible against RBBH's regulatory requirements for bail-in-able funding and have a maturity of 5 years with a non-callable period of 4 years. The project supports resilience of a local bank by helping RBBH build diversified funding base for the minimum requirement for own funds and eligible liabilities. The project contributes to the expansion of lending to private businesses through working capital lines and investment loans to SMEs, including enterprises operating in economically less developed regions of the country. Furthermore, the transaction supports RBBH's growth strategy and provides a source of medium term local currency funding. The bank will aim to allocate up to EUR 3.8 million of the proceeds to Green Economy Transition (GET) eligible projects.
